buttons.note_en: Personal, open-source, great for highway signs, CN-friendly. PMPK edition.

buttons.note_en: Ultimate slacking tool, lively bullet-chat, maintained by Pony, office essential.

buttons.description_en: A virtual AI world built on AlephPro's next-gen computing paradigm. After login, enter NoriOS with full interfaces (browser, files, terminal, email). Chat and play mini-games with the virtual anime character. Core gameplay revolves around 'compute' — grow your compute resources through story progression, but watch out: your compute server may come under attack at any time.
buttons.note: AlephPro 全新计算范式，二次元 AI 互动 + 算力经营玩法，完整体验需登录。
buttons.note_en: AlephPro next-gen computing. Anime AI interaction + compute management gameplay. Full experience requires login.

buttons.description_en: A Chinese Minecraft community forum (powered by Discuz). Offers JE texture/shader/modpack/map and MCBE resource downloads, with sign-in, tasks, follow and credit systems, plus active member & post leaderboards.

buttons.description: Minecraft 模组一站式开发平台：桌面开发工具内置 Agent 接入，授权后即可调用 AI 模型服务；按量计费、余额硬管控，余额不足自动冻结、充值秒级恢复，支持兑换码秒到账。
buttons.description_en: A one-stop platform for Minecraft mod development. Desktop dev tools come with built-in Agent integration granting AI model services on authorization; pay-as-you-go billing with hard balance control, auto-freeze when credit runs out and instant restore after top-up, redeem-code recharge.
buttons.note: 亲测可访问（已抓取验证）。模组开发者向的 AI 接入平台，兑换码在闲鱼自助购买。
buttons.note_en: Verified accessible. Mod-dev oriented AI integration platform; redeem codes self-purchased on Xianyu.

buttons.name: AutoMods
buttons.subtitle: automods.cn
buttons.author: AutoMods
buttons.description: 用对话做 Minecraft 模组：一句话说清想法，AI 自动生成并实时展示每一步（读写文件、改动、编译是否通过），产物 jar/源码/贴图/模型随时可下载；支持连续对话与透明过程，兼容 Fabric/Forge/NeoForge。
buttons.description_en: Make Minecraft mods by chatting: describe the idea in one sentence and AI generates it live, showing every step (files read/written, changes, build status); artifacts like jar/source/textures/models are downloadable anytime; supports ongoing dialogue and transparency, compatible with Fabric/Forge/NeoForge.
buttons.note: 亲测可访问（浏览器验证）。AI 对话式模组制作平台，微信扫码注册送 1000 积分，公测中。
buttons.note_en: Verified accessible via browser. AI dialogue-based mod creation platform; WeChat scan signup gives 1000 credits, in open beta.

buttons.name: Celestial Launcher
buttons.subtitle: celestial.wemsur.top
buttons.author: Wemsur
buttons.description: 免费开源的 Minecraft 游戏启动器，基于 Modrinth App 分叉。多版本库互不打扰、直接兼容现有 .minecraft（从 PCL/HMCL/官方启动器零成本迁移）、自定义主题色与背景、离线登录、完整汉化、无广告、自动更新。
buttons.description_en: A free & open-source Minecraft launcher forked from the Modrinth App. Multiple instance libraries that don't interfere, direct compatibility with existing .minecraft (zero-cost migration from PCL/HMCL/official launcher), custom accent color & background, offline login, full Chinese localization, ad-free, auto-update.
buttons.note: 亲测可访问（浏览器验证）。开源启动器，Linux/RPM/DEB 等各平台安装包齐全。
buttons.note_en: Verified accessible via browser. Open-source launcher with Linux/RPM/DEB packages.

buttons.name: nsos
buttons.subtitle: nsos.astras.cc
buttons.author: ningqi24
buttons.description: 一个运行在浏览器里的迷你移动操作系统（Web-based OS）。分层渲染、状态机驱动，含 Android 风格开机引导（Fastboot/Recovery）、桌面 Launcher、真锁屏、状态栏、终端与设置应用；内置统一命令引擎（shell），支持真实设备信息、虚拟文件系统、分区挂载、bootloader 解锁刷写等终端玩法。
buttons.description_en: A web-based mini mobile OS running in the browser. Layered rendering driven by state machine: Android-style boot (Fastboot/Recovery), desktop Launcher, real lock screen, status bar, terminal & settings apps; built-in unified shell command engine with real device info, virtual filesystem, partition mounting, bootloader unlock/flash.
buttons.note: 亲测：页面模拟完整 Android 开机流程（开机动画→锁屏→桌面），双击状态栏回锁屏；桌面终端命令真实可用（devinfo/df/mount/wipe/reboot/fastboot 等），Fastboot/Recovery 工程模式可进入，极客趣味十足。
buttons.note_en: Tested: simulates full Android boot flow (boot animation → lock screen → desktop). Desktop terminal commands really work (devinfo/df/mount/wipe/reboot/fastboot etc.). Fastboot/Recovery modes accessible. Geeky fun.

buttons.name: 02Engine
buttons.subtitle: 02engine.org
buttons.author: 0.2Studio
buttons.description: 02Engine 是 TurboWarp 的二次修改版编辑器（官网自称 mod of TurboWarp），主打极限速度与丰富扩展：移除帧率上限提升运行速度，整合 PenguinMod、TurboWarp 与社区扩展（工具/物理/3D/网络），内置扩展管理器与代码转换工具，为硬核用户打造。
buttons.description_en: 02Engine is a mod of TurboWarp focused on extreme speed and rich extensions: removes framerate cap for faster runtime, integrates PenguinMod, TurboWarp and community extensions (tools/physics/3D/network), with an expansion manager and code tools for hardcore users.
buttons.note: 亲测可访问（浏览器验证）。TurboWarp 二改编辑器，UI 较朴素但功能强大，适合极客玩家，稳定性一般。
buttons.note_en: Verified accessible via browser. TurboWarp mod with a plain UI but very powerful features for hardcore users; stability is so-so.

buttons.name: Bilup
buttons.subtitle: com.bilup.org
buttons.author: Bilup
buttons.description: Bilup 是基于 TurboWarp 的 Scratch 二次修改编辑器：保留熟悉的编辑器体验，加入 blocks-to-JS 编译器、大量插件与主题、项目打包器、调试器、Git 版本控制与实时多人协作，并附带账号体系的社区平台；免费开源，浏览器/桌面端皆可用。
buttons.description_en: Bilup is a Scratch modification built on TurboWarp: keeps the familiar editor and adds a blocks-to-JS compiler, a large set of addons and themes, a project packager, a debugger, git version control, live collaboration, and a community platform with accounts. Free and open source, works in browser or desktop.
buttons.note: 亲测可访问（浏览器验证）。TurboWarp 二改编辑器（用户所述 mistwarp 二改，实为 TurboWarp 二改），运行稳定，实时多人协作功能强大。
buttons.note_en: Verified accessible via browser. TurboWarp mod (reported as MistWarp mod, actually built on TurboWarp). Stable, with powerful live collaboration.

buttons.note_en: Verified accessible via browser. Open-source directory maintained by GabsTheCuriousKid, listing ~66 Scratch mods/editors.
